# Test fixtures

- `test_husky.jpg`: Stanford Dogs **test** split, `n02110185-Siberian_husky/n02110185_15019.jpg`, as written by `scripts/download_stanford_dogs.py`. It is never used for training, validation or calibration.
- Licence: Stanford Dogs is built from ImageNet images, which may only be used for non-commercial research and education. That is why only this one photo is in git; the dataset itself is downloaded by the script and git-ignored.
